VARIANT 07 — NOSTROMO REV 2 — SIX EDITORIAL MOVES OVER V06
Rotated mono text up the right edge:
at 35% opacity + tick marks. Breaks the grid.
Project Monitor in Hero Right Column
SpokeToWork mini map renders inside a CRT
status. Brand mark moves small + corner-anchored.
+ pulsing red REC indicator. Breaks the
green monotone. Doubles as availability hint.
left-column grid + crosses into the right.
Subtle cyan dropshadow tail for depth.
half stays mono, dimmer. Visually designer.
label points at Featured Work below. Closes
the hero, opens the scroll narrative.
Same Nostromo CRT aesthetic (phosphor green, near-black deck, scanlines, grain, italic-serif display, mono everything else).
Six editorial moves break the "stacked column developer portfolio" feeling: corner marker (1), project monitor (2), red
WARN + REC indicator (3), off-axis name (4), italic-serif designer tagline half (5), diagonal section divider (6).
Reads: working terminal w/ design weight. Less cosplay, more editorial. Brand mark de-emphasized; project work in the hero.
